name: research-workflow
description: A cross-domain learning and engineering research workflow that reuses existing tools and supports bounded autoresearch.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and audit reproducible research cycles.
interface.longDescription: Learn a domain through primary sources and mechanism exercises, reuse suitable open tools, and test engineering ideas through bounded, auditable experiments.
defaultPrompt: Use Research Workflow to learn a field and test one engineering question.
Compare existing tools before building a workflow for this project.
Freeze evaluation and a run ledger for a bounded autoresearch loop.
